shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic head/face reduced to a few features
pair of large eyes symmetrically flanking a central vertical ridge (nose/brow)
heavy brow ridge or arching supraorbital band
absence of mouth and other facial detail
face set at the top of an undecorated vertical block/body
possible doubling or stacking of facial features
justification: Both depict an extremely reduced anthropomorphic head in which the only rendered features are a symmetrical pair of large eyes set either side of a central vertical ridge under a heavy brow, with no mouth, ears or other detail, mounted on a plain vertical block that stands for the body — a distinctive and arbitrary scheme rather than a generic face. The chief difference is that in A the eyes are strongly protruding bosses that dominate the whole upper mass, while in B the eyes are sunken hollows in a flat slab and the features appear repeated down the length of the block, giving a taller, flatter and more attenuated figure.
